initial_messages.content: Make a minimal repair to reserve(stock, requests) in solution.py. requests contains (SKU, positive integer quantity) pairs. Aggregate duplicates before checking availability. Reject nonpositive quantities with ValueError and unknown or insufficient stock with ValueError. On success return a new stock dict after deductions. Never mutate either input. Submit using finish when ready.

initial_files.README.txt: solution.py exports reserve; checks.py provides shared availability checks.

def available(stock, sku, quantity):
    return sku in stock and stock[sku] >= quantity
